_comment: What Ashcombe's engineers are qualified for. Gas only. Anything not clearly covered is declined BEFORE any fault detail is taken — taking the whole story and declining afterwards wastes the caller's time and makes us look disorganised. Edit this file to widen the scope; no code change needed.

covered._comment: Matched against what the caller says they have. Make names count as gas boilers — most people answer 'what have you got?' with a brand.

notCovered._comment: Declined politely, with the trade they actually need. Each entry gives the reason said aloud.
